mapper.select: select id, name, student_no, status from student where id = #{studentId}

select avg(moral_score) as moral, avg(skill_score) as skill, avg(thinking_score) as thinking, avg(smart_score) as smart from dimension_evaluation where student_id = #{studentId} and period_end between #{start} and #{end}

select id, subject, exam_name, score, full_score, occurred_on, created_by from score_record where student_id = #{studentId} and occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by occurred_on desc, id desc limit 100

select id, period_start, period_end, moral_score, skill_score, thinking_score, smart_score, evidence, created_by from dimension_evaluation where student_id = #{studentId} and period_end between #{start} and #{end} order by period_end desc, id desc limit 100

select id, dimension, score, title, detail, occurred_on, source, created_by from growth_record where student_id = #{studentId} and occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by occurred_on desc, id desc limit 100
select id, attendance_date, status, note, created_by from attendance_record where student_id = #{studentId} and attendance_date between #{start} and #{end} order by attendance_date desc limit 100

select id, skill_name, score, level, occurred_on, evidence, created_by from skill_record where student_id = #{studentId} and occurred_on between #{start} and #{end} order by occurred_on desc, id desc limit 100
select count(*) from score_record where student_id = #{studentId} and subject = #{subject} and exam_name = #{examName}
mapper.insert: insert into score_record(student_id, subject, exam_name, score, full_score, occurred_on, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{subject}, #{examName}, #{score}, #{fullScore}, #{occurredOn}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: select id from attendance_record where student_id = #{studentId} and attendance_date = #{date} order by id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into attendance_record(student_id, attendance_date, status, note, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{attendanceDate}, #{status}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: update attendance_record set status = #{status}, note = #{note}, created_by = #{actor} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into skill_record(student_id, skill_name, score, level, occurred_on, evidence, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{skillName}, #{score}, #{level}, #{occurredOn}, #{evidence}, #{createdBy})

insert into growth_record(student_id, dimension, score, title, detail, occurred_on, source, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{dimension}, #{score}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{occurredOn}, #{source}, #{createdBy})

insert into dimension_evaluation(student_id, period_start, period_end, moral_score, skill_score, thinking_score, smart_score, evidence, created_by) values (#{studentId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{moralScore}, #{skillScore}, #{thinkingScore}, #{smartScore}, #{evidence}, #{createdBy})
